shockedScenarios.reason: FTP series computed for base scenario "S0" only. Shocked-scenario series are refused this window (the shocked-NII path convention is pinned at v1 semantics; a series on that convention would be wrong by one coupon month). Refused for: S100, S-100, S200, S-200.

derived.note: Display-only aggregation of engine attribution rows into per-driver waterfall steps, summed in the build step so the client renders and never computes.

showBeforeRun.rationale:
Instruction: "MMA betas +15bp, CD renewal 75%"
Compiled 2 overlay parameter changes versus base "AS-BASE", authored as data and shown before any run:
- mma / deposit-beta: params.betaMax 0.8 -> 0.9500000000000001
- cds / cd-rollover: renewalProbability 0.6 -> 0.75
No balance-sheet figure is computed at compile time; only run() produces numbers.
